Interface LPCCompilationEnvironment

All Known Implementing Classes:
LPCCompilerContext, MudlibRuntimeContext
public interface LPCCompilationEnvironment
Read-only services used while compiling LPC source.

Compilation can inspect sources, compatibility policy and callable signatures. It cannot instantiate game objects, open sessions, mutate a world or connect to storage. A hosted instance assembles this environment before asking the compiler to analyze its mudlib.
